arxiv-2002-12021.title: Dataset Search In Biodiversity Research: Do Metadata In Data Repositories Reflect Scholarly Information Needs?
arxiv-2002-12021.creator: Felicitas Löffler*, Valentin Wesp, Birgitta König-Ries, Friederike Klan
arxiv-2002-12021.description: Abstract The increasing amount of publicly available research data provides the opportunity to link and integrate data in order to create and prove novel hypotheses, to repeat experiments or to compare recent data to data collected at a different time or place.

arxiv-2106-09217.title: Conditions for justifying single-fluid approximation for charged and neutral dust fluids and a smoothed particle magnetohydrodynamics method for dust-gas mixture
arxiv-2106-09217.creator: Y. Tsukamoto, M. N. Machida, S. Inutsuka
arxiv-2106-09217.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Y. Tsukamoto, M. N. Machida, S. Inutsuka. We describe a numerical scheme for magnetohydrodynamics simulations of dust-gas mixture by extending smoothed particle magnetohydrodynamics. We employ the single-species particle approach to describe dust-gas mixture with several modifications from the previous studies. We assume that the charged and neutral dusts can be treated as single-fluid and the electro-magnetic force acts on the gas and that on the charged dust is negligible.

arxiv-2111-08661.title: Quantification of fracture roughness by change probabilities and Hurst exponents Journal: Mathematical Geoscience
arxiv-2111-08661.creator: Tim Gutjahr, Sina Hale, Karsten Keller, Philipp Blum, Steffen Winter
arxiv-2111-08661.description: Abstract The objective of the current study is to utilize an innovative method called ‘change probabilities’ for describing fracture roughness. In order to detect and visualize anisotropy of rock joint surfaces, the roughness of one-dimensional profiles taken in different directions is quantified. The central quantifiers, ‘change probabilities’, are based on counting monotone changes in discretizations of a profile.

arxiv-2203-01606.title: Ensemble Methods for Robust Support Vector Machines using Integer Programming
arxiv-2203-01606.creator: Jannis Kurtz
arxiv-2203-01606.description: Abstract In this work we study binary classification problems where we assume that our training data is subject to uncertainty, i.e. the precise data points are not known. To tackle this issue in the field of robust machine learning the aim is to develop models which are robust against small perturbations in the training data.

arxiv-2206-05672.title: The Proton Gluon Distribution from the Color Dipole Picture
arxiv-2206-05672.creator: G.R. Boroun, M. Kuroda, Dieter Schildknecht
arxiv-2206-05672.description: Abstract Employing the representation of the experimental data on deep inelastic electron-proton scattering (DIS) in the color-dipole picture (CDP), we determine the gluon distribution of the proton at small Bjorken x x . At sufficiently large momentum transfer, Q 2 Q^{2} , the extracted gluon distribution fulfills the standard evolution equation for the proton structure function.

arxiv-2209-11249.title: A close quasar pair in a disk-disk galaxy merger at z = 2.17 z=2.17
arxiv-2209-11249.creator: Yu-Ching Chen 1,2, Xin Liu 1,2, Adi Foord 3, Yue Shen 1,2, Masamune Oguri 4,5, Nianyi Chen 6, Tiziana Di Matteo 6,7,8, Miguel Holgado 6, Hsiang-Chih Hwang 9, & Nadia Zakamska 10
arxiv-2209-11249.description: Abstract Galaxy mergers produce pairs of supermassive black holes (SMBHs), which may be witnessed as dual quasars if both SMBHs are rapidly accreting. The kiloparsec (kpc)-scale separation represents a physical regime sufficiently close for merger-induced effects to be important [ 1 ] yet wide enough to be directly resolvable with the facilities currently available.

arxiv-2305-09942.title: Design, construction, characterization, and testing of one-channel electronic module for the Hamamatsu Multi-Pixel Photon Counter S12572-100P
arxiv-2305-09942.creator: J. Félix
arxiv-2305-09942.description: Abstract The Multi-Pixel Photon Counter (MPPC) or Silicon Photomultiplier (SiPM) can detect from a single photon to several thousand ones; it has high gain — 10 5 10^{5} to 10 6 10^{6} —, low operation voltage —65 to 75 Vdc—, and small size —typically 3.85 mm × \times 4.35 mm × \times 1.

arxiv-2311-08155.title: Displacement sensing using bi-modal resonance in over-coupled inductors
arxiv-2311-08155.creator: Alexis Hernandez Arroyo, George Overton*, Anthony J. Mulholland, Robert R. Hughes*
arxiv-2311-08155.description: Abstract This paper presents the theory and key experimental findings for an investigation into the generation of bimodal resonance (frequency splitting) phenomena in mutually over-coupled inductive sensors, and its exploitation to evaluate relative separation and angular displacement between coils. This innovative measurement technique explores the bimodal resonant phenomena observed between two coil designs - solenoid and planar coil geometries.

arxiv-2405-07349.title: WeedScout: Real-Time Autonomous blackgrass Classification and Mapping using dedicated hardware
arxiv-2405-07349.creator: Matthew Gazzard, Helen Hicks, Isibor Kennedy Ihianle, Jordan J. Bird, Md Mahmudul Hasan, Pedro Machado
arxiv-2405-07349.description: Abstract Blackgrass (Alopecurus myosuroides) is a competitive weed that has wide-ranging impacts on food security by reducing crop yields and increasing cultivation costs. In addition to the financial burden on agriculture, the application of herbicides as a preventive to blackgrass can negatively affect access to clean water and sanitation.

arxiv-2505-21652.title: PartInstruct: Part-level Instruction Following for Fine-grained Robot Manipulation
arxiv-2505-21652.creator: Yifan Yin Zhengtao Han Shivam Aarya Jianxin Wang Shuhang Xu Jiawei Peng, [0.05in] Angtian Wang Alan Yuille Tianmin Shu, [0.05in] Johns Hopkins University ShanghaiTech University[0.05in] https://partinstruct.github.io
arxiv-2505-21652.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yifan Yin Zhengtao Han Shivam Aarya Jianxin Wang Shuhang Xu Jiawei Peng, [0.05in] Angtian Wang Alan Yuille Tianmin Shu, [0.05in] Johns Hopkins University ShanghaiTech University[0.05in] https://partinstruct.github.io. Fine-grained robot manipulation, such as lifting and rotating a bottle to display the label on the cap, requires robust reasoning about object parts and their relationships with intended tasks.

arxiv-2505-23144.title: Flux Globalization Based Well-Balanced Path-Conservative Central-Upwind Schemes for Shallow Water Linearized Moment Equations
arxiv-2505-23144.creator: Yangyang Cao, Qian Huang, Julian Koellermeier, Alexander Kurganov, and Yongle Liu
arxiv-2505-23144.description: Abstract We develop second-order path-conservative central-upwind (PCCU) schemes for the hyperbolic shallow water linearized moment equations (HSWLME), which are an extension of standard depth-averaged models for free-surface flows. The proposed PCCU schemes are constructed via flux globalization strategies adapted to the nonconservative form via a path-conservative finite-volume method.

arxiv-2511-11296.title: Online Spectral Density Estimation
arxiv-2511-11296.creator: Shahriar Hasnat Kazi
arxiv-2511-11296.description: Abstract This paper develops the first online algorithms for estimating the spectral density function — a fundamental object of interest in time series analysis — that satisfies the three core requirements of streaming inference: fixed memory, fixed computational complexity, and temporal adaptivity.

arxiv-2604-25971.title: A Lie-algebraic Criterion for the Universality of Exponentiated Quantum Gates
arxiv-2604-25971.creator: Yinuo Xue, Qian Chen, Jing-Song Huang

pmc-10627159.title: Trends in exercise for hypertension: a bibliometric analysis
pmc-10627159.creator: Yan Lou, Ning Sun, Min Zhang, Yongzhen Qiu, Jie Wang, Jiajia Chen
pmc-10627159.description: ObjectiveTo investigate development trends and research hotspots of exercise for hypertension research and provide researchers with fresh perspectives for further studies.Materials and methodsArticles and reviews regarding exercise and hypertension spanning May 1st 2003 to May 18th 2023 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (WOSCC) database.

pmc-10672610.title: Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation in Acute Ischemic Stroke in the Setting of Reperfusion Therapy: Insights and Strategies for Optimized Care
pmc-10672610.creator: Jay Patel, Sonu M M Bhaskar, Thomas Brand, Narayanaswamy Venketasubramanian
pmc-10672610.description: Reperfusion therapy in the form of intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) and endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) has revolutionised the field of stroke medicine. Atrial fibrillation (AF) patients constitute a major portion of the overall stroke population; however, the prevalence of AF amongst acute ischemic stroke (AIS) patients receiving reperfusion therapy remains unclear.

pmc-11291670.title: Whole-genome demography of COVID-19 virus during its pandemic period and on “panvalent” vaccine design
pmc-11291670.creator: Byung-Ju Kim, JaeJin Choi, Sung-Hou Kim
pmc-11291670.description: With over 16 million submitted genomic sequences, the SARS-CoV-2 (SC2) virus, the cause of the most recent worldwide COVID-19 pandemic, has become the most sequenced genome of all known viruses, revealing, for example, a vast number of expanding viral lineages.

pmc-11540453.title: Effectiveness of Non-Pharmacological Interventions for Spasticity Management in Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review
pmc-11540453.creator: Bhasker Amatya, Fary Khan, Krystal Song, Mary Galea
pmc-11540453.description: This systematic review aims to determine the effectiveness of non-pharmacological interventions for the management of spasticity in people with multiple sclerosis (pwMS). A comprehensive literature search in health science databases (MEDLINE, Embase, CENTRAL, CINHAL) was performed to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) (up to April 2024).

pmc-11634194.title: The role of fluorescent cholangiography to improve operative safety in different severity degrees of acute cholecystitis during emergency laparoscopic cholecystectomy: a prospective cohort study
pmc-11634194.creator: Antonio Pesce, Nicolò Fabbri, Luca Bonazza, Carlo Feo
pmc-11634194.description: Background:Currently, there is limited scientific evidence regarding the effectiveness of fluorescent cholangiography in emergency cholecystectomy for acute cholecystitis. The primary aim of this study was to assess the efficacy of near-infrared fluorescent cholangiography (NIRF-C) in different severity degrees of acute cholecystitis.

pmc-12358714.title: NAT2: A Novel Target in Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma and its Role in Modulating Tumor Behavior
pmc-12358714.creator: Xiyun Chen, Guang Yang, Cheng Lou, Yulong Dong, Zhengang Yuan
pmc-12358714.description: Background:Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) is a primary liver cancer typically diagnosed at advanced stages, limiting treatment options and reducing survival rates. Targeted therapy presents a promising strategy to improve outcomes. This study aims to identify novel molecular biomarkers influencing ICC development and explore their roles in tumor progression.

pmc-12586236.title: cis- and trans-elements for the transcriptional regulation of sugar responsive genes: from current knowledge to future applications
pmc-12586236.creator: María-Isabel Cruz-López, Josefat Gregorio, Elizabeth Cordoba
pmc-12586236.description: Sugar metabolism in plants is highly dynamic throughout their life cycle, driven by the continuous production, accumulation, and distribution of these molecules along the plant body. To cope with fluctuating sugar levels during their life cycle, plants have developed mechanisms to sense and respond to these changes accordingly.

pmc-12814593.title: Distribution of HLA-ABC allele groups in a cohort of Chilean rheumatoid arthritis patients and healthy individuals
pmc-12814593.creator: Miqueas Jaime, Lucero Toro, Constanza Varela-Villarroel, Darly Montano-Bruno, Bárbara Pesce, Daniela Schneider, Lilian Soto, Francisca Bozán, Óscar Neira, María C Cuéllar-Gutiérrez, Consuelo Arroyo, Guido Rivera, Eduard Palou, Diego Catalán, Jaxaira Maggi, Juan C Aguillón
pmc-12814593.description: BackgroundRheumatoid Arthritis (RA) is an autoimmune disease in which HLA-DRB1 alleles encoding the “Shared Epitope” (SE), located in the β-chain of class II HLA-DR molecules, constitute the main genetic risk factor. However, there is scarce information about the role of HLA class I genes (HLA-ABC) in RA susceptibility.

pmc-13319529.title: Thermodynamic process of entropy generation and MHD convection in porous cavity saturated with MWCNT-Fe3O4/H2O hybrid nanofluid: Darcy–Forchheimer–Brinkmann model
pmc-13319529.creator: Syed M. Hussain, Aissani Abdelkader, Fares Redouane, Hidki Rachid, Adnane Mohammed, Kamel Guedri, Mohamed R. Eid, Hijaz Ahmad, Mustafa Bayram, Muhammad Amer Qureshi
pmc-13319529.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This research focuses on examining heat transfer and entropy generation within a porous cavity, which contains a hybrid nanofluid known as MWCNT-Fe3O4/H2O, due to its relevance to improving thermal management systems as well as increasing energy efficiency. The study is based on an advanced Darcy–Forchheimer–Brinkmann computational model that considers inertial forces, the fluid filling the cavity, and the resultant effects of applying a magnetic field. To provide the laminar and incompressible nature of the nanofluids flux, the Darcy–Forchheimer prototype is essential.

pmc-13519952.title: Biliary Atresia With Situs Inversus Abdominalis Managed by Kasai Portoenterostomy: A Case Report From Muhimbili National Hospital, Tanzania
pmc-13519952.creator: Rajabu Athumani Bakari, Alfred Chibwae, Brian Kimanthi, Tariq Aziz, Georvin Marco Haule, Novath Ngowi, Ally Hamisi Mwanga, Zaitun M Bokhary
pmc-13519952.description: Biliary atresia associated with situs inversus abdominalis is a rare congenital combination that complicates diagnosis and surgical orientation. Early recognition, meticulous preoperative planning, and timely Kasai portoenterostomy can achieve favorable short‐term outcomes. Surgeons should consider anatomical variations to optimize operative safety and improve biliary drainage and prognosis.
